hackathon_mentors_accepted_check.name: hackathon_mentors_accepted_check
hackathon_mentors_accepted_check.value: "hackathon_mentors"."status" != 'accepted' OR ("hackathon_mentors"."user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "hackathon_mentors"."helps_with" IS NOT NULL)

hackathon_prizes_value_check.name: hackathon_prizes_value_check
hackathon_prizes_value_check.value: ("hackathon_prizes"."value_amount_minor" IS NULL AND "hackathon_prizes"."value_currency" IS NULL) OR ("hackathon_prizes"."value_amount_minor" > 0 AND "hackathon_prizes"."value_currency" IS NOT NULL)

hackathon_submissions_urls_check.name: hackathon_submissions_urls_check
hackathon_submissions_urls_check.value: ("hackathon_submissions"."repository_url" IS NULL OR length("hackathon_submissions"."repository_url") <= 2048) AND ("hackathon_submissions"."demo_video_url" IS NULL OR length("hackathon_submissions"."demo_video_url") <= 2048)

hackathon_submissions_complete_check.name: hackathon_submissions_complete_check
hackathon_submissions_complete_check.value: "hackathon_submissions"."status" = 'draft' OR ("hackathon_submissions"."track_id" IS NOT NULL AND "hackathon_submissions"."repository_url" IS NOT NULL AND "hackathon_submissions"."ai_statement" IS NOT NULL AND "hackathon_submissions"."original_work_attested_at" IS NOT NULL)

projects_slug_check.name: projects_slug_check
projects_slug_check.value: length("projects"."slug") BETWEEN 3 AND 80 AND "projects"."slug" NOT GLOB '*[^a-z0-9-]*' AND "projects"."slug" NOT GLOB '-*' AND "projects"."slug" NOT GLOB '*-' AND "projects"."slug" NOT GLOB '*--*'

projects_text_check.name: projects_text_check
projects_text_check.value: length(trim("projects"."title")) BETWEEN 1 AND 100 AND length("projects"."problem") <= 500 AND length("projects"."description") <= 2000

projects_urls_check.name: projects_urls_check
projects_urls_check.value: ("projects"."repository_url" IS NULL OR length("projects"."repository_url") <= 2048) AND ("projects"."demo_url" IS NULL OR length("projects"."demo_url") <= 2048) AND ("projects"."website_url" IS NULL OR length("projects"."website_url") <= 2048)
